verdict.rationale: GitBook's docs describe autonomous AI behaviors (auto-flagging outdated content, auto-translations, AI insights) and git-based sync triggers, but there is no evidence of a user-configurable rules/automation engine where users define custom event→action triggers (e.g., webhooks, if-this-then-that logic). Missing for 10: any documented rules/trigger builder, webhook or event-condition-action framework, or examples of users defining custom automation logic.
